governance_note: V1 aggregate results were observed before this V2 was stated. No V1 row-level winner/loser feature analysis or exit-path optimization was performed. V2 adds one economic invalidation rule and is a separate strategy contract.
entry: next legal executable session open after the frozen V1 signal
target: +10% from executable entry, first legal realization after T+1
failure: after the position is legally sellable, the first completed daily coordinate close at or below the upward true-gap lower boundary (the prior session coordinate high) invalidates repricing; exit at the next legal executable open
time_stop: H20, then next legal executable open
confirmation: Apply the identical fixed contract to 2019-2021; require average completed trades/year >50, pooled mean net >3%, pooled median >0, and every confirmation-year mean >0.
outcomes_opened_at_v2_freeze: V1 aggregates only; no V2 replay
